description.value: You constantly wander the maze of life, moving from one interest to the next; as a result, it's easy to forget past passions while delving into others. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Additional Lore] feat, as well as the benefits of @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Unmistakable Lore] for that Lore subcategory, even if you don't meet the prerequisites. You can retrain Maze Lost to a different Lore skill subcategory with 1 day of downtime.
